mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cpk.tb_attch_pic_mng_info (prk_plce_manage_no, prk_plce_info_sn, prk_plce_type, prk_oper_type, seq_no, ext_nm, file_path, file_nm, real_file_nm, prk_img_id, reg_dt, rgst_id, rgst_ip_addr) VALUES (#{prkPlceManageNo}, #{prkPlceInfoSn}, #{prkPlceType}, #{prkOperType}, #{seqNo}, #{extNm}, #{filePath}, #{fileNm}, #{realFileNm}, #{prkImgId}, NOW(), #{rgstId}, #{rgstIpAddr})
mapper.select: SELECT prk_plce_info_sn AS prkPlceInfoSn, prk_img_id AS prkImgId, seq_no AS seqNo, real_file_nm AS realFileNm, file_nm AS fileNm, file_path AS filePath, ext_nm AS extNm, reg_dt AS regDt FROM cpk.tb_attch_pic_mng_info WHERE prk_plce_info_sn = #{prkPlceInfoSn} ORDER BY prk_img_id, seq_no
